title: Rabbit Symptom Checker
description: This symptom checker is not a diagnosis tool and does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain,…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk tool page block
Page: Rabbit Symptom Checker: When To Call A Vet
URL: /rabbit-symptom-checker/

How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit/create the "Rabbit Symptom Checker" page.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old page content with everything below.

SEO plugin settings:
SEO title: Rabbit Symptom Checker | When To Call A Rabbit Vet
Meta description: Use our rabbit symptom checker to spot urgent warning signs such as not eating, not pooing, bloating, head tilt, flystrike signs, breathing problems and sudden weakness.
Focus keyphrase: rabbit symptom checker
URL slug: rabbit-symptom-checker

Important:
- This page is a general triage guide, not a diagnosis tool.
- Keep the urgent vet wording strong. Rabbits can deteriorate quickly.
-->

<section class="rcsym-page alignfull" id="rabbit-symptom-checker">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-warn: #9a6a1c;
      --rc-warn-soft: #fff5df;
      --rc-safe: #4e6b45;
      --rc-safe-soft: #eff8ed;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcsym-page,
    .rcsym-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcsym-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcsym-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcsym-page a:focus-visible,
    .rcsym-page button:focus-visible,
    .rcsym-page input:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcsym-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcsym-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcsym-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcsym-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcsym-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcsym-btn,
    .rcsym-check-button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcsym-btn:hover,
    .rcsym-check-button:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcsym-btn-primary,
    .rcsym-check-button {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcsym-btn-danger {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7d2d24, var(--rc-danger));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.24);
    }

    .rcsym-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcsym-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcsym-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rcsym-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcsym-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.74), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.36) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.08)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcsym-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcsymFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcsym-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 850px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcsym-hero-title-overlay .rcsym-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rcsym-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcsym-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 650px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcsym-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcsym-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcsym-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcsym-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcsym-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 740px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcsym-hero-card,
    .rcsym-panel,
    .rcsym-side-card,
    .rcsym-tool,
    .rcsym-result,
    .rcsym-symptom-card,
    .rcsym-tip,
    .rcsym-related-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcsym-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcsym-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-danger); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rcsym-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rcsym-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcsym-hero-card li::before {
      content: "!";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcsym-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcsym-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcsym-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcsym-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rcsym-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rcsym-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rcsym-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rcsym-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rcsym-section-header { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rcsym-section h2,
    .rcsym-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcsym-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 700px;
    }

    .rcsym-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcsym-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcsym-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcsym-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcsym-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcsym-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rcsym-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcsym-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rcsym-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcsym-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rcsym-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rcsym-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcsym-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rcsym-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcsym-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcsym-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcsym-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    /* Symptom checker */
    .rcsym-tool-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcsym-tool {
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcsym-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 26px);
      border-radius: 30px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rcsym-fieldset {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
    }

    .rcsym-fieldset legend {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcsym-check {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 58px;
      padding: 13px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      background: #ffffff;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcsym-check:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.28); }

    .rcsym-check input {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      accent-color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rcsym-check strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcsym-check span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcsym-check:has(input:checked) {
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      border-color: rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.42);
    }

    .rcsym-result {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 34px);
      border-radius: 34px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.2), transparent 18rem),
        #ffffff;
    }

    .rcsym-result-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .rcsym-status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
    }

    .rcsym-status.emergency { background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcsym-status.soon { background: var(--rc-warn-soft); color: var(--rc-warn); }
    .rcsym-status.monitor { background: var(--rc-safe-soft); color: var(--rc-safe); }

    .rcsym-result h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.65rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .rcsym-result p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 720;
    }

    .rcsym-result-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcsym-result-list li {
      padding: 13px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.92);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 780;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.08);
    }

    .rcsym-result-list li strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcsym-emergency-box {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 850;
    }

    .rcsym-emergency-box strong { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcsym-symptom-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcsym-symptom-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 230px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .rcsym-symptom-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcsym-symptom-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }

    .rcsym-symptom-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcsym-symptom-card p { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcsym-level {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-self: flex-start;
      margin-top: auto;
      padding: 7px 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--rc-warn-soft);
      color: var(--rc-warn);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 950;
    }

    .rcsym-level.emergency { background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcsym-level.monitor { background: var(--rc-safe-soft); color: var(--rc-safe); }

    .rcsym-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcsym-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcsym-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcsym-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }

    .rcsym-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcsym-warning-list li {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 850;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcsym-tips-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcsym-tip {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcsym-tip:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }

    .rcsym-tip b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }

    .rcsym-tip h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcsym-tip p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcsym-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcsym-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-hay.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

            <p>Head tilt, rolling or loss of balance needs prompt rabbit-savvy veterinary advice.</p>
            <span class="rcsym-level emergency">Urgent</span>
          </article>

          <article class="rcsym-symptom-card">
            <b>🦷</b>
            <h3>Drooling or chewing trouble</h3>
            <p>Wet chin, dropping food or difficulty chewing may suggest dental pain or mouth problems.</p>
            <span class="rcsym-level">Same-day advice</span>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcsym-section rcsym-reveal" id="what-to-do">
      <div class="rcsym-wrap">
        <div class="rcsym-section-header">
          <span class="rcsym-pill">While you call the vet</span>
          <h2>What to do if your rabbit seems unwell</h2>
          <p>
            Keep your rabbit calm and safe while arranging veterinary advice. Avoid home treatment unless your vet tells you what to do.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcsym-tips-grid">
          <article class="rcsym-tip">
            <b>📞</b>
            <h3>Call first</h3>
            <p>Tell the vet exactly what changed: eating, droppings, breathing, posture, movement and when it started.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcsym-tip">
            <b>🧺</b>
            <h3>Prepare a carrier</h3>
            <p>Use a secure carrier with soft bedding, hay if appropriate and safe temperature control.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcsym-tip">
            <b>🚫</b>
            <h3>Avoid guessing treatment</h3>
            <p>Do not give medicines, force-feed or try home remedies unless a vet has advised it for this situation.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcsym-section rcsym-faq rcsym-reveal" id="faq">
      <div class="rcsym-narrow">
        <div class="rcsym-section-header">
          <span class="rcsym-pill">FAQs</span>
          <h2>Rabbit symptom checker questions</h2>
          <p>Quick answers about urgent rabbit warning signs and when to contact a rabbit-savvy vet.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcsym-faq-list">
          <details class="rcsym-faq-item">
            <summary>Is not eating an emergency in rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Yes. If your rabbit stops eating or stops passing droppings, contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently. Rabbits can become seriously unwell quickly.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcsym-faq-item">
            <summary>What if my rabbit is still eating but seems quieter than usual?</summary>
            <p>Monitor closely and check appetite, droppings, posture and behaviour. If the change continues, worsens or your instincts say something is wrong, call your vet.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcsym-faq-item">
            <summary>Can I treat my rabbit at home first?</summary>
            <p>Do not give medicine, force-feed or try home remedies unless your vet has advised it. Some problems need examination first, especially if there could be a blockage, severe pain or breathing problem.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcsym-faq-item">
            <summary>Does this checker diagnose my rabbit?</summary>
            <p>No. It is only a general urgency guide. A rabbit-savvy vet is needed to examine your rabbit and diagnose the cause.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcsym-final rcsym-reveal">
      <div class="rcsym-wrap rcsym-final-box">
        <span class="rcsym-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Trust your instincts and act early</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits often hide illness until they are very unwell. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems bloated, is breathing strangely, has collapsed or shows sudden severe changes, contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently.
        </p>
        <p>
          Early advice is safer than waiting and hoping things improve.
        </p>

        <div class="rcsym-btns">
          <a class="rcsym-btn rcsym-btn-secondary" href="#checker">Check symptoms again</a>
          <a class="rcsym-btn rcsym-btn-primary" href="/rabbit-health">Read the rabbit health guide</a>
        </div>
      </div>

          <span class="rcsym-pill">Keep reading</span>
          <h2>Related rabbit care guides</h2>
          <p>More useful guides for rabbit health, diet, safe foods and housing.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcsym-related-grid">

      <div class="rcsym-wrap">
        <p>
          <strong>RabbitCare.co.uk provides general rabbit care information for UK owners.</strong>
          This symptom checker is not a diagnosis tool and does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain, has breathing problems, collapses or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet urgently.
        </p>

  </main>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById("rcsymForm");
      const status = document.getElementById("rcsymStatus");
      const count = document.getElementById("rcsymCount");
      const title = document.getElementById("rcsymTitle");
      const text = document.getElementById("rcsymText");
      const advice = document.getElementById("rcsymAdvice");
      const emergencyBox = document.getElementById("rcsymEmergencyBox");

      if (!form) return;

      function selectedSymptoms() {
        return Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="symptom"]:checked')).map(function (input) {
          return {
            value: input.value,
            level: input.getAttribute("data-level"),
            label: input.closest("label").querySelector("strong").textContent
          };
        });
      }

      function updateResult(event) {
        if (event) event.preventDefault();

        const selected = selectedSymptoms();
        const hasEmergency = selected.some(function (item) { return item.level === "emergency"; });
        const hasSoon = selected.some(function (item) { return item.level === "soon"; });
        const hasMonitor = selected.some(function (item) { return item.level === "monitor"; });

        count.textContent = selected.length === 0 ? "No symptoms selected" : selected.length + " selected";

        if (selected.length === 0) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status";
          status.textContent = "Ready to check";
          title.textContent = "Select symptoms to get urgency guidance.";
          text.textContent = "The checker will suggest whether you should contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently, call for same-day advice or monitor closely.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "block";
          advice.innerHTML = '<li><strong>Reminder:</strong> This checker does not diagnose illness.</li><li><strong>Vet advice:</strong> Call your vet if you are worried or unsure.</li>';
          return;
        }

        if (hasEmergency) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status emergency";
          status.textContent = "Urgent vet advice";
          title.textContent = "Contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently.";
          text.textContent = "One or more selected symptoms can be serious in rabbits. Do not wait to see if it improves, especially if your rabbit is not eating, not pooing, bloated, struggling to breathe, collapsed or showing flystrike signs.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "block";
          advice.innerHTML =
            '<li><strong>Call now:</strong> Explain the symptoms, when they started and whether your rabbit is eating and passing droppings.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Do not guess treatment:</strong> Avoid medicines, force-feeding or home remedies unless a vet advises them.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Prepare safely:</strong> Keep your rabbit calm, secure and at a comfortable temperature while arranging care.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Selected symptoms:</strong> ' + selected.map(function (item) { return item.label; }).join(", ") + '.</li>';
          return;
        }

        if (hasSoon) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status soon";
          status.textContent = "Call for advice";
          title.textContent = "Call a rabbit-savvy vet for advice today.";
          text.textContent = "The selected symptoms may need veterinary attention, especially if they are new, worsening or linked with reduced appetite, fewer droppings or pain signs.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "none";
          advice.innerHTML =
            '<li><strong>Call today:</strong> Ask your vet whether your rabbit should be examined.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Monitor closely:</strong> Keep checking appetite, droppings, behaviour and movement.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Escalate quickly:</strong> If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, becomes weak or seems in pain, treat it as urgent.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Selected symptoms:</strong> ' + selected.map(function (item) { return item.label; }).join(", ") + '.</li>';
          return;
        }

        if (hasMonitor) {
          status.className = "rcsym-status monitor";
          status.textContent = "Monitor closely";
          title.textContent = "Monitor closely and call if it continues.";
          text.textContent = "A mild change may not always be an emergency if your rabbit is still eating, pooing and behaving mostly normally, but rabbits can hide illness.";
          emergencyBox.style.display = "none";
          advice.innerHTML =
            '<li><strong>Watch appetite:</strong> Check that your rabbit is eating hay and normal food.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Check droppings:</strong> Look for normal quantity and size of poos.</li>' +
            '<li><strong>Trust your instincts:</strong> Call your vet if the change continues, worsens or feels unusual.</li>';
        }
      }

      form.addEventListener("submit", updateResult);
      form.addEventListener("change", updateResult);
      updateResult();
    })();
  </script>
</section>
</div>
